description_en: Modifies the blocked locations that are configured in the Location Blacklist (Domain Names) policy for a website
description_zh: 设置网站业务区域封禁（针对域名）的封禁地区
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-area-block --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyun.com --regions CN-310000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebAreaBlock

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name whose configurations you want to modify.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的域名。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The regions from which you block requests.

If you do not configure this parameter, the Blocked Regions (Domain Names) policy is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
要封禁的地域列表。

不设置该参数表示关闭区域封禁（针对域名）功能
